name: American Collegiate, Washington DC
description: American Collegiate, Washington DC offers students a unique year 1 university program, designed for high-achieving international students aspiring to attend some of America's top universities. This elite first-year program at American University prepares international students to seamlessly continue as a year 2 student at American University or transfer into another highly ranked university with expert guidance.Located at American University, students spend year one learning from faculty at a Top 100 university where they earn year 1 academic credits from American University and additional cultural, English, and standardized testing support necessary to succeed at the most competitive U.S. universities. Students are routinely accepted into Top 100 and Top 50 ranked universities including, but not limited to, New York University (NYU), Boston College, Boston University, University of Southern California, Purdue University, and Emory University.  Timestamps Updated
